# Terrain tile bank: 36 columns of 16 x 48 stacked (frame i = tile i; the order is tilemap.txt's index). PF2 pens 1-7 =
# the island palette (mission 4's colours here, the copper swaps each mission's). Shading is baked: no mirrored tiles.
